_comment: Character voices for RVC. The model files are far too large for git, so
they are downloaded on first install instead.
Each entry needs a 'url' pointing at a direct download. Two shapes work:
* a .zip holding the voice's .pth and .index (any nesting - the archive
* a bare .pth, with the matching .index given as 'index_url'
'sha256' is optional; when present the download is verified against it.
'size_mb' is only used to show a sensible progress bar before the server
Host these anywhere that serves the file directly: a GitHub release asset,
Hugging Face (.../resolve/main/...), or your own storage. A Google Drive or
Mega share page is NOT a direct link and will download an HTML page.
Voices are also perfectly fine to install by hand: drop <Name>/<any>.pth
into models/rvc/ and the server picks it up with no manifest entry at all.
